wikipediaArticleRead.support: The Geber entry at L2712 says Geber was son of Uri and one of Solomon’s regional administrators. It establishes the relation to Uri in 1 Kings 4:19, but gives no independent biography of Uri.

sourceTextExcerpts.text: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and he was the only officer who was in the land.
